manualInspection.method: Frame strips extracted from the decoded GIF, in time order; inspected E and S.
findings: E: contact/passing poses recur without a convincing opposite-leg half-cycle.
S: the same foreground boot remains prominent instead of clear left-right alternation.
Stable height and unique pixel hashes do not establish a valid walk cycle.

limitations: Foot silhouette similarity is diagnostic and cannot identify anatomical left/right by itself.
No claim of passing visual gait inspection for the other six directions.
Foot sliding in world movement is not tested by this stationary GIF.
